scope: ME4 Deoxys Psy Protection; no artwork, BREAK or JAR.

ruleReferences.facts: Basic Deoxys130HP, Psychic type, Psy Protection PPC80, J, Darkness weakness2, Fighting resistance30, retreat3. Energy icon links inspected individually; rule text matches local ME4 033.
M4 033/083, Basic130HP, サイコプロテクト80; text says no attack damage from Pokemon possessing Abilities during next opposing turn.

ruleReferences.status: Opened successfully,4 results; relevant question/answer at text lines92-95
ruleReferences.questionParaphrase: With Team Rocket's Watchtower in play, can Cinccino ex Energy Slap damage an opposing Deoxys protected by Psy Protection?
ruleReferences.answerParaphrase: Yes: Watchtower has removed all of Cinccino ex's Abilities, so Psy Protection does not apply.
ruleReferences.proves: Use current possessed Ability state with removal/suppression, not printed profile presence and not a snapshot taken when Deoxys used Psy Protection.

ruleReferences.kind: Official analogue only: Full Face Guard possession/removal timing
ruleReferences.facts: A Rayquaza VMAX loses its Ability under Path to the Peak and qualifies for Full Face Guard. Rewind Beam damage precedes devolution, so later loss/change of Ability does not revise prior damage. Gastro Acid example also confirms damage uses pre-effect state.
ruleReferences.limitation: These are Full Face Guard examples, not additional Deoxys rulings; Gastro Acid answer does not by itself prove every later-turn activation-lock interaction.

reviewedSemantics: Two actual-source fact construction paths use hasPossessedAbilities(owner,pokemon). Frozen damage facts are captured after BEFORE_ATTACK and retained after later restoration/leave for secondary damage. Non-damage dynamic protection queries use live actual actor. No use of donor, current replacement Active, printed-only or activeAbilities.

ProtectionEffect.FIELDS derives from AttackSourceFilter.FIELDS; preflight derives from ProtectionEffect.FIELDS. PassiveAttackGuard and DamageTakenModifier likewise consume source filters. Existing registry/schema/resumable architecture needs no opcode/example addition. Strict malformed flag, typo and sourceABILITY are component-tested.
No dependency rule broadened. Existing HAS_ABILITIES removal cycle still rejects; source filter on suppress_abilities rejects. Regression suites validate current canonical possession behavior.
Preserved old 2/4/6 argument AttackSourceFilter constructors and old 6 argument Facts constructor; old Facts Ability proof is null, only new required predicate fails closed.

localPrintAudit.name: Deoxys
localPrintAudit.exactRulePrintEvidence: Full 14,198-card report has exactly one cardId with archetype -1036422763 and one Psy Protection attack: me4_en_033. Raw ME4 includes normal and reverse-holo rows with identical rule data; these are one combat ID, not two rules cards. ME4 031,032,034 and other same-name Deoxys have different attacks and are not siblings.

evidenceLimitations: Direct exact サイコプロテクト FAQ query returned tool InternalError; the actual same question was successfully recovered and opened through Team Rocket's Watchtower query.
Official English Deoxys Q&A link https://asia.pokemon-card.com/sg/rules/search/?keyword=Deoxys returned cache miss.
Attempts to open Alolan Vulpix VSTAR / Snow Mirage FAQ queries returned InternalError. No claim of a recovered Alolan Vulpix ruling.

No direct Deoxys FAQ located for temporary ability-use/effect locks, copied attacks, damage counters, or extra turns. These boundaries follow printed scope and existing audited engine contracts; identified as inference/implementation requirements.
No live tests were run in this research. Source fit and proposed extension require component and actual-card runtime verification before support is enabled.

abilityPossessionContract.requiredQuery: ServerMatch.hasPossessedAbilities(owner,pokemon), currently lines1388-1392; same canonical query used by HAS_ABILITIES condition.
abilityPossessionContract.whyNotActiveAbilities: activeAbilities returns empty when a temporary disable_abilities effect prevents functioning/activation. That is distinct from losing/erasing all Abilities; using it would disagree with the preexisting possession contract.
abilityPossessionContract.whyNotPrintedProfile: profile.abilities alone ignores Team Rocket's Watchtower and other true removal, violating the actual Deoxys FAQ.
abilityPossessionContract.existingImplementation: hasPossessedAbilities checks abilitySuppressed and zoneSuppressionSourceId exemptions, then battlefield.abilities. Thus it respects persistent removal and preserved exempt source abilities, while bypassing a mere temporary ability-effects lock.
abilityPossessionContract.snapshot: Capture possessed-ability Boolean for the actual attacker in resolveDeclaredAttackDamage after genuine BEFORE_ATTACK changes, alongside current energy/status Facts. Keep that same fact for primary and secondary attack damage. Normal AFTER_ATTACK removals/restorations must not retroactively rewrite attack damage. Non-damage source filter queries should receive live authoritative facts when relevant.
abilityPossessionContract.noRecursion: Reuse existing acyclic hasPossessedAbilities. Do not define an Ability-removal condition that depends on HAS_ABILITIES or on this new filter; AbilitySuppressionProgram.validateDependency already rejects that cycle.
